messages:
leah: customer reports sudden 429s on bulk ingestion even though Console shows plenty of credits left. ticket #4567. request ids: req_abc123, req_def456. customer: 'started getting 429s around 10:12 PST, nothing changed on our side'
marco: which region and plan? any sampling ids?
leah: us-west-2, dedicated-reserved, sample curl + header pasted in ticket. I've attached a small .har.
ivy: quick thought — Console reads from the aggregated writer index which is eventually consistent; enforcer reads live counters. If the writer was behind we'd see enforcement without dashboard evidence.
jon: is that the same async pipeline we observed in the last billing incident? any schema migrations recently?
marco: pulling enforcer traces for req_abc123...
marco: enforcer log: "rate_limit check -> bucket: cust-123 | allow=false | remaining=-1 | window=60s" at 2024-11-02T17:12:03Z. Key hash v3.
alerts-bot: deploy-pipeline: batch-writer v2 rolled to prod at 2024-11-02T16:58:00Z (rollout id: r-20241102-58)
ivy: that rollout time aligns. hypothesis: writer schema change produced keys not parsed by aggregator, causing a lag where Console shows stale counts. enforcer still decremented live counters -> customer sees 429s.
leah: customer wants ETA and mitigation. can we flip anything short-term?
marco: we can turn on a temporary "soft-enforce" flag scoped to cust-123 for 1h so enforcer returns warnings instead of 429s. requires Product TTL approval.
jon: okay to do targeted softening for cust-123 for 1 hour while we push a fix. Ivy, can aggregator accept both key formats?
ivy: yes, I'll add tolerant parsing to aggregator and a migration to reindex malformed keys. prepping patch now. staging deploy ETA ~2h.
marco: reproduce steps I'm using:
```
# reproduce (internal)
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"bulk"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate --header 'x-cust: cust-123'
# tail enforcer logs for req id
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=enforcer --since=2m | grep req_abc123
# query writer lag metric
SELECT max(ingest_lag_seconds) FROM writer_metrics WHERE shard='shard-12';
```
ivy: found aggregator errors: parsing failed for 0.03% of keys; writer emitted keys with postfix ":v2" instead of ":v1" in some shards during the rollout. aggregator filter ignored them.
marco: writer lag spikes: 39s at time of incident. correlation looks strong.
leah: customer update drafted: "we've found a short-lived schema mismatch during a writer rollout causing dashboard counts to lag enforcement. mitigation applied (soft-enforce) and we will follow up with timeline and postmortem."
jon: please add a dashboard alert: if enforcer 429 rate >0 AND writer_ingest_lag > 20s for same shard -> page eng-oncall.
marco: adding alert and dashboard panel now. also adding a one-off backfill to reconcile counts for affected shards.
ivy: PR opened: https://stash.redwood.com/PR/8181 (aggregator: accept v1/v2 keys + unit tests). I'll link CI run.
alerts-bot: ci: PR 8181 -> build passed on staging at 2024-11-02T19:05:00Z
leah: I'll send the customer the mitigation note and ETA for a full reconciliation.
jon: mark this for a short postmortem if fix confirms root cause. tagging @eng-releases @eng-sre for rollout notes.
ivy: will include repro steps and a small data-migration plan in the PR.
leah: thanks everyone :thumbsup
